newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies end mixed, most recover from lows.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies end mixed, most recover from lows.

text.p: Nov 26 - IMM currencies finished mixed in a recovery from early session lows as the dollar returned to familiar ground. Traders await Japan's tankan report. IMM currencies close at 1200 CST/1800 GMT on Wednesday for the Thanksgiving holiday. No trading Thursday and market closes early again Friday. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
